name: glitchr/omnilab
description: Omnilab: one contract for the public science-data APIs - entities (a compound, a gene, a protein, a species, a star, an earthquake) with their properties, units and cross-references, series (a variable measured at a place over time: weather, climate, air) and catalogued products (a satellite scene, a dataset, STAC-like) - whatever the domain; a Collector that follows cross-references from one base to the next, and a Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnilab/pubchem: PubChem: compounds by CID, name, InChIKey, CAS or SMILES, their computed properties, synonyms, structure image and cross-references
suggest.omnilab/open-meteo: Open-Meteo: hourly and daily weather series at a point, forecast and historical archive
suggest.omnilab/copernicus: Copernicus Data Space: Sentinel, Landsat and Copernicus service products from its STAC catalogue
suggest.omnilab/chebi: ChEBI: chemical entities by ChEBI id, InChIKey, CAS, KEGG or name, their structure, ontology (classes, roles) and cross-references
suggest.omnilab/wikidata: Wikidata: any item by Q-number, by a science base's identifier or by label, its labels in a language, its cross-references and a few properties with units
suggest.omnilab/chembl: ChEMBL: bioactive molecules by ChEMBL id, InChIKey or name, their development phase, computed properties, mechanisms of action and targets, cross-references from UniChem
suggest.omnilab/uniprot: UniProt: proteins of UniProtKB by accession or entry name, their function, gene, organism, sequence, mass, cofactors and ligands, their genes in NCBI and Ensembl
suggest.omnilab/ncbi: NCBI Gene and Taxonomy: genes by GeneID, taxa by id or name, their location, summary and lineage, their UniProt, Ensembl and GBIF ids
suggest.omnilab/gbif: GBIF: taxa of its taxonomy (the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release) by key, legacy Backbone number, NCBI id or scientific name, their status, IUCN category and lineage
suggest.omnilab/simbad: SIMBAD (CDS): objects beyond the solar system by any identifier, their type, coordinates, motion, parallax, velocity, redshift, spectral type and magnitudes
suggest.omnilab/jpl: NASA/JPL Small-Body Database: asteroids and comets by number, designation or name, their orbit, physical parameters, NEO and PHA flags, close approaches and impact risk
suggest.omnilab/usgs: USGS earthquake catalogue (ComCat): an earthquake by its id with its time and place, the earthquakes of a box or around a point as series
suggest.omnilab/ensembl: Ensembl: genes, transcripts, proteins and exons by Ensembl id, genes by symbol in a species, their place on the genome, biotype and assembly, their NCBI Gene and UniProt entries
suggest.omnilab/pdb: RCSB PDB: structures of the Protein Data Bank by PDB id, their method, resolution, citation, chains and ligands, their UniProt proteins and ligands as related things; a full-text search
suggest.omnilab/inaturalist: iNaturalist: taxa by id or name, their common name, IUCN status, lineage and default photo with its licence; the observations of a place and a period, research grade by default
suggest.omnilab/noaa: NOAA: weather and climate observations as series at a point - NCEI's station records (GHCN-Daily, monthly and yearly summaries) and the National Weather Service's observations and forecasts in the United States
suggest.omnilab/cds: Copernicus Climate Data Store: its datasets (ERA5, seasonal forecasts, projections) as products over a place and a period, its catalogue's search; with an account's key, a request submitted and followed to its file
suggest.omnilab/cams: Copernicus Atmosphere Data Store (CAMS): air quality forecasts and reanalyses, atmospheric composition, greenhouse gases as products, through omnilab/cds
suggest.omnilab/exoplanets: NASA Exoplanet Archive: confirmed exoplanets by name, their mass, radius, orbit and temperature with uncertainties, their discovery and their host star, related by its designations (SIMBAD, Gaia DR3)
suggest.omnilab/gaia: ESA Gaia DR3: a source by its source_id or designation, its astrometry (position, parallax, proper motion), photometry, radial velocity and astrophysical parameters; the sources of a cone on the sky
suggest.omnilab/reactome: Reactome: pathways and reactions by stable id (R-HSA-70171), their compartments, GO process, inputs and outputs, their participants (UniProt proteins, ChEBI molecules) as related things; a search; the pathways of a protein or a molecule
suggest.omnilab/earthdata: NASA Earthdata (CMR): the granules of NASA's Earth observation collections (HLS, MODIS, VIIRS, GPM...) as products by place, period and cloud cover; their files with an Earthdata Login token
suggest.omnilab/kegg: KEGG (academic use only): compounds, drugs, reactions, pathways and enzymes by KEGG id, their formula, masses, equations and classes, CAS, ChEBI, ChEMBL and Rhea ids, their reactions, pathways and enzymes as related things; a search
suggest.omnilab/rhea: Rhea: biochemical reactions by any of their four Rhea ids or their KEGG reaction, their equation, sides and participants; ChEBI participants, EC numbers, GO term, Reactome events and the reviewed UniProt proteins that catalyse them as related things; a search
suggest.omnilab/string: STRING: a protein by STRING id, UniProt accession or name, its interaction partners with their scores as related things; networks with each evidence channel's score; functional enrichment
suggest.omnilab/interpro: InterPro: InterPro entries and Pfam families by accession, their type, members, GO terms and hierarchy; a UniProt protein's domains and families, with their positions, as related things; a search
suggest.omnilab/quickgo: QuickGO (EBI): Gene Ontology terms by id, their definition, aspect, parents and children; a UniProt protein's GO annotations by aspect and evidence; a search
suggest.omnilab/hgnc: HGNC: human genes by HGNC id, symbol, previous symbol or alias, their approved name, location, groups and MANE Select transcript; their NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt and OMIM ids
suggest.omnilab/opentargets: Open Targets Platform: targets (Ensembl genes), diseases (EFO, Mondo, HPO, Orphanet) and drugs (ChEMBL), their associations with scores, drugs and clinical candidates; a search
suggest.omnilab/clinvar: ClinVar (NCBI E-utilities): variations by VariationID or VCV accession, their clinical significance, review status, conditions, genes, location and frequencies, their dbSNP id; a search
suggest.omnilab/gwas: GWAS Catalog: studies, variants (rs ids) and traits (EFO, Mondo, HPO) with their strongest associations; p-values, effect sizes, risk alleles; a search of traits
suggest.omnilab/cod: Crystallography Open Database: crystal structures by COD id, their formula, unit cell with uncertainties, space group and publication, the CIF as a file; a search
suggest.omnilab/cactus: NCI/CADD Chemical Identifier Resolver: a structure from a name, CAS number, InChIKey, InChI or SMILES, its InChIKey, InChI, SMILES, IUPAC name, formula, weight, CAS numbers and names; OPSIN for a name it cannot read
suggest.omnilab/codata: CODATA fundamental physical constants as NIST publishes them (2022): each constant by NIST's short name or its name, its value, uncertainty and unit, exact or not; a search
suggest.omnilab/materials-project: Materials Project (an account's key): computed properties of inorganic materials by mp id, their formula, symmetry, energies, band gap and moduli; the materials of a formula or a chemical system
suggest.omnilab/oqmd: OQMD: DFT formation energies, hull distances and band gaps of materials by OQMD id, composition or phase space
suggest.omnilab/emsc: EMSC (SeismicPortal FDSN): an earthquake by its id with its time and place, the earthquakes of a box or around a point as series or occurrences
suggest.omnilab/usgs-water: USGS Water Data (OGC APIs): streamflow, gage height and other parameters of a monitoring location as recorded or daily; monitoring locations
suggest.omnilab/tides: NOAA CO-OPS (Tides and Currents): water levels, verified hourly heights, highs and lows, tide predictions and water temperature of a station
suggest.omnilab/swpc: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center: the aurora at a point as a series; the Kp index, the solar wind, alerts and scales outside the contract
suggest.omnilab/brightsky: Bright Sky (Deutscher Wetterdienst open data): hourly observations and MOSMIX forecasts at a point or a DWD/WMO station
suggest.omnilab/elevation: Open Topo Data: the elevation of points and profiles from SRTM, ASTER, EU-DEM, GEBCO and other elevation models (outside the contract)
suggest.omnilab/openaq: OpenAQ API v3: hourly and daily air quality averages at the nearest location of a point (a key required)
suggest.omnilab/obis: OBIS (Ocean Biodiversity Information System): marine taxa by WoRMS AphiaID or name with their record counts; the occurrences of a box or around a point, by taxon and depth
suggest.omnilab/worms: WoRMS (World Register of Marine Species): taxa by AphiaID, name, ITIS TSN, NCBI or IUCN id; classification, synonyms, vernaculars, citation; ITIS, NCBI and IUCN cross-references
suggest.omnilab/itis: ITIS: taxa by TSN or name; usage, accepted name, hierarchy, common names, geographic divisions and jurisdictional origins; a search of names
suggest.omnilab/col: Catalogue of Life (ChecklistBank): taxa and synonyms by COL id, GBIF key (the same id since 2026) or name; GBIF, iNaturalist, WoRMS and ITIS cross-references
suggest.omnilab/pbdb: Paleobiology Database: fossil and living taxa with their first and last appearances in Ma; fossil occurrences by place and age (outside the contract)
suggest.omnilab/ebird: eBird API 2.0: bird taxa by species code; with the user's key, names, search, checklists and recent observations (not tested live)
suggest.omnilab/iucn: IUCN Red List API v4: taxa with their latest global assessment, with the user's token (not tested live)
suggest.omnilab/horizons: NASA/JPL Horizons: the ephemeris of a planet, moon, asteroid, comet or spacecraft seen from a place on the Earth as series (RA, Dec, azimuth, elevation, magnitude, distances, elongation)
suggest.omnilab/mpc: IAU Minor Planet Center: minor planets and comets by number, designation or name; designations, orbit, absolute magnitude, observation arc; their latest observations (outside the contract)
suggest.omnilab/ned: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database: galaxies, quasars and clusters by any name; type, position, redshift, NED's data counts; the objects of a cone on the sky (outside the contract)
suggest.omnilab/vizier: CDS VizieR: astronomical catalogues' tables by text as datasets; the rows of a table around a point of the sky or an object (outside the contract)
suggest.omnilab/donki: NASA DONKI: space weather events (solar flares, CMEs, geomagnetic storms, shocks, SEP events) by activity id, or by period (outside the contract)
suggest.omnilab/launches: The Space Devs' Launch Library 2: orbital launches by id, text or period, as occurrences at their pads (15 calls an hour without a key)
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle itself
